'''Mechis III''' was a rocky, smoky and [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which served as one of the prime [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturers in the galaxy. Covered in automated droid building facilities, it provided the galaxy with all manner of droids for generations. Many of the galaxy's largest droid designers subcontracted the construction work to the plants on Mechis III, where the automated systems were highly efficient.

Mechis III was the homeworld of the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[E-3PO]] and was also subsequently overcome by [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88 assassin droids]] during the [[Mechis III Uprising]].

==History==
In the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] it served as one of the many droid foundries of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]], [[Genetech Corporation]], [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]]. It was also the headquarters of [[Trilon, Inc./Legends|Trilon, Inc.]], a ship producing company.

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] had complete control of the planet after the dissolution of the Techno Union. Sometime before [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] the planet's central computer was electronically sliced into by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]] and their sentience was uploaded. By taking control of Mechis III, the IG-88 assassin droids planned to use the planet as a base for the planned [[Droid Revolution|droid revolution]]. The plot involved killing all the 73 living Arakyd employees on the planet, while concurrently assuming control of the company, continuing to fill the standard droid orders with every droid manufactured by the foundry being modified to be similarly self-aware like IG-88 and ready to rebel against the 'biologicals' when triggered.<ref name="Tale of IG-88">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

However, the final IG-88's destruction with the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] ended their potential rebellion and organic life returned to planet and restored its proper droid manufacturing.

Years after IG-88's defeat, [[Tyko Thul]] purchased the droid factory and restored it to peak manufacturing operations.
